attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"finally snapped up the last stretch of the river road","severity":"major","reason":"The briefing says only that a trading post opened; it says nothing of a last stretch or a takeover."},{"span":"the locals say it's just convenient for them","severity":"major","reason":"Invented reported speech from unnamed locals."},{"span":"The Red Gully Raiders have been quiet lately","severity":"minor","reason":"Asserts the raiders' recent behaviour, which the briefing never mentions."},{"span":"likely bringing more snow than usual","severity":"minor","reason":"Adds scale to the cold snap forecast."},{"span":"anyone trying to reach the distant coast","severity":"major","reason":"Introduces a coast the briefing does not name."},{"span":"This will probably make travel difficult","severity":"minor","reason":"Implied consequence of the cold snap, beyond what the briefing gives."}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin is readable and leads with the right news, but it embroiders both items with unsupported claims: the 'last stretch' of road, the locals' quote and a coast the briefing never names. The voice is only mildly wry, and 'One assumes' reads more like speculation than dry wit."}
